key_changes.artifact_integrity: Validator that rejects SSH/PTY errors, malformed JSON, placeholders, zeroed hashes, and missing artifacts. The exact corruption that invalidated B4 ('Error: Your SSH client doesn't support PTY') is now detected and rejected.
key_changes.manifest_system: Versioned manifest with SHA-256 hashing, byte sizes, schema versions, and provenance. ManifestBuilder creates manifest.json with model, dataset, counterfactuals, representations, PCA, policies, shams, qualification, and environment sections.
key_changes.leakage_checks: Framework checking task ID overlap, exact prompt overlap, retrieval store contamination, PCA train-only fit, policy selection leakage, group/template cross-split leakage, and representation sanity (NaN/inf/variance/dimensionality).
key_changes.corrected_stats: Group-local paired positive-group computation (not global baseline). Paired group bootstrap with full statistics (mean, median, 2.5/97.5 percentiles, SE, P>0). Matched sham evaluation with paired comparison (not percentile of regret differences).
key_changes.frozen_lifecycle: Explicit experiment states: DEVELOPMENT → FROZEN → RUNNING → QUALIFIED/FAILED. Config hash enforcement prevents tuning after observing FINAL. Experiment registry tracks all experiments with invalidation support.
key_changes.action_rename: action.retrieval.vector renamed to action.retrieval.lexical (it was keyword overlap, not vector retrieval). Backward-compatible alias retained.
key_changes.b5_action_space: Four actions: direct_fast (/no_think, 512 tokens), direct_think (thinking on, 2048 tokens), retrieval.examples (lexical), reasoning.decompose. FAST vs THINK differs in inference compute, not model.
key_changes.b5_dataset: 12 task families with within-family crossovers (easy/medium/hard tiers). Winner distribution diagnostics verify ≥2 actions each win ≥15% per family. OOD split included.
key_changes.b5_policies: LinearQPolicy, RidgeQPolicy (DEV-tuned alpha), MLPQPolicy (128→128→64→4). All train on full counterfactual utility regression, not winner classification. Surface-feature baselines (subtype, prompt_length, TF-IDF).
key_changes.b5_qualification: Seven frozen gates: beats best fixed, beats surface, beats sham, positive oracle capture (≥25%), breadth (≥65% positive groups), no leakage, artifact integrity. Any hard gate failure = NOT QUALIFIED.
key_changes.reproduction_command: python -m daph_learning.executive.reproduce --artifact-root <path> verifies artifact hashes, reloads data, recomputes metrics, and compares to stored qualification JSON.
key_changes.synthetic_pipeline: End-to-end integration test with fake executors and synthetic hidden features. Runs dataset generation → counterfactual execution → representation → PCA → policy training → sham → qualification → manifest → verification. No GPU required.
